name: PhotoCraft
description: Headless PSD-compatible image editor (PhotoCraft from ArtCraft, open source, written in Rust). Opens photos and layered documents (PSD/PSB, TIFF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, XCF, Krita, OpenRaster, SVG…), edits them with 500+ commands of the desktop app — crop and resize, layers and masks, adjustment layers, filters (sharpen, blur, noise…), brightness/contrast, levels, curves, type — renders PNG previews and exports PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, PSD and more.
instructions:
PhotoCraft runs headless in your own container; every file lives in /work.

1. Upload the user's image to /work and open it: doc_open {"path":"/work/photo.jpg"} (PSD/PSB, TIFF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, HEIC, XCF, KRA, ORA, SVG, .pcraft…). For a blank canvas use doc_new {"width":1920,"height":1080}.
2. Find the command: command_list {"filter":"crop"} (also "sharpen", "contrast", "levels", "resize", "blur"…). The registry has 500+ commands, so always pass a filter; never list them all. Each entry's params tells the parameters and their ranges; doc_inspect shows the document size, layers and history.
3. Run it: command_run {"id":"image.crop","params":{"x":0,"y":112,"width":1200,"height":675}}, command_run {"id":"filter.sharpen.smartSharpen","params":{"amount":80}}, command_run {"id":"image.adjustments.brightnessContrast","params":{"contrast":30}}. Several steps at once go through command_batch {"steps":[{"id":...,"params":{...}}, ...]}. Undo with command_run {"id":"edit.undo"}.
4. Check the result: doc_inspect, and render_preview {} saves a PNG preview into /work and returns its path (no inline image) — download it to look at it or to show it.
5. Export: doc_export {"path":"/work/<name>.png"}; the extension picks the format (png, jpg, webp, tif, psd, psb, gif, bmp, tga, exr, pdf…; quality for JPEG/WebP). Use a new file name for every export. To continue editing later keep the layers: doc_save {"path":"/work/<name>.psd"} or .pcraft.
6. Hand the result over: download it from /work with plugin_download_file.

All paths must be inside /work; relative paths resolve against /work. A new MCP session (e.g. after a reconnect) starts with no open document, so save layered work (.psd/.pcraft) after each stage and reopen it then. The container and /work are deleted after the conversation is idle, so always download the results.

accepts.description: HEIC photo from an iPhone or Mac (read only)
TIFF image (.tif/.tiff), flat or with Photoshop layers
SVG drawing, opens as shape layers
PDF pages to rasterize and edit

returns.description: Edited image as WebP (lossy or lossless)
Edited image as TIFF, optionally with layers
PhotoCraft document to continue editing later
